name: Rose, Thorn, Bud
trigger: Product discovery sprints, UI/UX iterations, and collaborative design-engineering syncs.

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive before any note is written.
Gather data (15m): silent notes into Rose, Thorn, Bud.
Generate insights (15m): turn the strongest Buds into spike candidates.
Decide (10m): timebox one Bud as a discovery ticket with an owner.
Close (5m): name one Thorn the next sprint will remove.

action: The chosen Bud becomes a timeboxed discovery ticket; the Thorn it would remove is written on the ticket so the two stay linked.
provenance: Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.
